visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark blue short dress and a black backpack, stands on a bright green grassy hill under a clear blue sky. She looks out towards a calm blue sea where a small triangular island, Keelung Islet, is visible in the distance. (2) The scene cuts to the woman walking along a low concrete fence on the grassy ridge, turning her head to look at the sea. Yellow captions appear at the bottom. (3) She walks across a flat grassy area towards a stone-brick bunker structure built into a hillside, with stone stairs leading up the grassy mound. (4) The camera follows her as she enters a narrow, dark stone tunnel, then looks back with a smile. (5) A high-angle drone shot reveals a wider view of the coastline, showing red port cranes and industrial ships in the distance, with the woman standing on a high ridge. (6) She is seen climbing a steep set of old stone stairs surrounded by dense green trees and foliage, holding onto a metal railing. (7) Reaching a viewpoint at the top, she points towards the sea and the islet. (8) She enters a small, well-maintained stone building with a traditional tiled roof. Inside, she explores exhibits, including a backlit map and a timeline on the wall. (9) The video ends with her standing on the hilltop again, arms outstretched, cheering towards the camera with the sea behind her.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features Baimiwong Fort in Keelung, showing lush green hills, historical stone bunkers and batteries, a steep stone staircase through a forest, panoramic views of the Keelung harbor with industrial cranes, and the isolated Keelung Islet in the ocean. There is also a visitor center with a Japanese-style stone and tile exterior.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Scenic Exploration -> Historical Site Highlights -> Facility Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce Baimiwong Fort in Keelung as a hidden, free travel destination. It emphasizes the combination of historical ruins (bunkers), hiking challenges (100 steps), and panoramic sea views, targeting local travelers looking for non-crowded weekend spots.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of jump cuts and rapid narrative shifts to maintain engagement. The combination of drone aerials and ground-level handheld shots effectively showcases the scale and details of the landmark.
